project_type: independent playable prototype with recovered artifacts preserved as references
legacy_input_api: UnityEngine.Input (provided by Unity; no separate UPM dependency)
notes: Unity 2022.3.62f3 compiled the assemblies and generated player data, but failed during WebGL post-processing with IndexOutOfRangeException; the built-in template is now explicitly selected for the next attempt. A successful WebGL build is not yet confirmed.
